entries.description: Indexed list of every Zap Studio documentation page with a one-line summary, for agents that want to fetch only the relevant pages.
The complete Zap Studio documentation for all packages in one Markdown file, for agents that need full context in a single request.
A zero-dependency, tree-shakeable in-memory key-value cache with pluggable eviction policies (LRU, LFU, FIFO), capacity limits, and optional TTL.
A type-safe, tree-shakeable fetch wrapper for HTTP requests with runtime schema validation.
A lean, tree-shakeable logging abstraction with a console implementation.
Result/Option types and Rust-style functional combinators for explicit, type-safe error handling.
Zap Studio's oxfmt preset: sorted imports, sorted package.json, and an optional Tailwind CSS class-sorting extension.
Zap Studio's oxlint preset: exclusive, single-owner rule sets — pick exactly the presets your project needs, nothing implied.
A type-safe, declarative, tree-shakeable authorization library for TypeScript with Standard Schema support.
Small, focused, tree-shakeable React hooks — one hook, one subpath, no forced bundle.
Composable, tree-shakeable retry policies for resilient async operations.
A small, tree-shakeable, framework-agnostic state container with auto-tracked derived values and optional built-in persist.
React bindings for @zap-studio/store: a useStore hook that subscribes a component to a createStore/derive instance.
Tree-shakeable Standard Schema utilities and ValidationError helpers.
A lightweight, type-safe, tree-shakeable webhook router with Standard Schema validation, signature verification, and lifecycle hooks.
